# GOG — March 2012 release announcement

- Original source: [Release: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood](https://www.gog.com/forum/general_archive/new_release_robin_hood_the_legend_of_sherwood/post15)
- Author / publication: GOG release announcement, preserved in its forum archive.
- Language / date: English; 2012-03-06.
- Access: Full thread retrieved directly across six page captures (posts 1 to 78)
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes, post by post (forum thread, not transcribed)

GOG announces the game’s arrival on its service for a historical price of $9.99. The announcement emphasizes a DRM-free package with extras, a team of characters with distinct abilities, and infiltration, ambush, and castle-attack missions.

This documents a particular digital distribution milestone, separate from the original Windows release and later preservation changes. The price belongs to the 2012 announcement and is not a current offer. Its claims about atmosphere, authenticity, and quality are promotional judgments.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: forum thread "Release: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood" in GOG's "General discussion (archive)" forum; thread header shows 78 posts across 6 pages; page 1 (posts 1 to 15, all dated March 06, 2012) was retrieved first and pages 2 to 6 (posts 16 to 78) in a second pass, all directly from gog.com, with some interface strings rendered in French. The opening post is by the account GOG.com (role "Editor"). Forum content, not transcribed.

### Post 1: GOG.com (Editor), March 06, 2012, release announcement

- Opens with a quoted ballad stanza about "Robyn Hode" under the greenwood who robbed the speaker of a hundred pounds, credited to Arthur Quiller-Couch (ed.), The Oxford Book of Ballads, 1910.
- Announces the release of Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood on GOG.com "for $9.99", addressed to fans of "stealth tactical combat or green tights and goatees".
- Story summary: King Richard imprisoned, Prince John tyrannizing; player is Robin of Sherwood facing the Prince and his minions; a small group of merry men "(+ Maid Marian)" with special abilities and attributes helps the player explore, infiltrate and complete several mission types in historic locations: Sherwood Forest, Nottingham Castle, Lincoln, York, Leicester and Derby.
- Developer context: made by the studio that also created Desperados: Wanted Dead or Alive and Desperados 2: Cooper's Revenge (both linked to their GOG game cards).
- Feature claims: combines strategy, ambush, spying, infiltration and hand-to-hand combat "within a simple and highly intuitive interface"; missions range from robbery and infiltration to "castle attack" and ambush; "all nine characters" have specific abilities; 12th-century England with rendered graphics, detailed environments, and atmospheric conditions of day, night and fog.
- Closing pitch: recommended for team-based strategy fans or anyone interested in the legend, "DRM-free, packed-with-goodies GOG.com release for only $9.99".

Facts the thread page establishes: launch price $9.99 on March 6, 2012; the game had been sold by DotEmu before the GOG release (per deonast); no dedicated GOG game forum existed on launch day (per dirtyharry50). No technical claims about the GOG build appear in the retrieved posts.

Points of record from the full thread: Windows 7 slowdown reports against the 1.1 build within two weeks of launch, a user-reported fix by GOG before the thread ended, the DotEmu edition's multi-language offering versus GOG's English-only package, prior availability on GamersGate, Steam, Impulse, DotEmu and Strategy First, and the 236 MB versus 1283 MB download-size discrepancy.
